concepts.label: Adaptive Index (functional array index using PAIRS())
concepts.note: a feature/index-type page built on top of CREATE INDEX + array indexing, not itself a distinct statement

relations.subject: n1ql:adaptive-index
relations.note: structural link from existing Markdown xref; page states Adaptive Index is built over Array Indexing technology
relations.evidence: Adaptive Indexes are bound to the limitations of Array Indexes because they are built over [Array Indexing](indexing-arrays.md) technology.

relations.subject: n1ql:adaptive-index
relations.note: structural link from existing Markdown xref
relations.evidence: An adaptive index is a type of array index. To create an adaptive index, the overall syntax is the same as for an array index. Refer to the [CREATE INDEX](createindex.md) statement for details of the syntax.

notable_absence.finding: Unlike the sibling feature pages Flex Indexes ('Starting with Couchbase Server 6.6...') and Array Indexing ('Couchbase Server 5.0 and later provides a simpler syntax...'), this page never states which Couchbase Server version introduced the Adaptive Index / PAIRS() feature. There is also no privilege or edition-restriction section, whereas ALTER INDEX (same n1ql reference tree) explicitly documents both an RBAC role requirement and an Enterprise-Edition restriction.
